Pettyjohn Electronics Iron MKII Standard Overdrive Pedal quantity Add to cart Description The Pettyjohn IRON MKII is a full re-work of our classic medium gain overdrive. Since its release over three years ago the IRON has become one of our most popular drives. The IRON has been loved for its ability to musically thicken your tone with the harmonic richness and touch sensitivity of vintage American amps pushed to the edge of breakup. Originally developed as a second stage drive as part of the PettyDrive, it excels at being a second stage drive, stacking on top of another, largely in thanks to the clean mix feature. We have listened to feedback from players and dealers alike and have come up with a refined IRON MKII exemplifying Pettyjohns uncompromising approach in studio-grade tone engineering and product aesthetic. The IRON MKII also represents Pettyjohn Electronics step toward more modular and customized pedal builds. Were proud to announce the IRON MKII offers four customizable upgrades to build the ultimate tool for tone. High voltage power! 36 Volts of internal power from standard 9v adaptor (200mA) Relay True Bypass switching Soft touch switch with totally quite switching and auto-bypass when power is off HIGHS and LOWS wide range sweepable filters Clipping mix knob, blend between Silicon and LED clipping Increased headroom and lower noise on all stages Active output level control for no tone loss and clean boost power Discrete Opamp Upgrade Option Upgrade to CHIME MKII Deluxe and the input and output stages become powered with our Studio Grade dual 990 style discrete opamp for extra clarity and depth Knobs and Labels Easier to read on stage Foundry Series MKII custom enclosure with in-set screws Box and circuit handmade in the beautiful Pacific Northwest, USA Dimensions: 2.75W x 4.75L x 2.5 H You May Also Like Disaster Area Designs DMT-1 Micro Tap Tempo Footswitch Universal Version $ 20.27 Original price was: $20.27. $ 12.16 Current price is: $12.16.
